The '''Sunburst Talisman''' was a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith talisman]] created through the use of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] in ancient times. Shaped in the form of a sunburst, the Talisman had been shattered into four large pieces that were spread between abandoned alchemical sites in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aloxl/Legends|Aloxl]]. While the talisman had been lost, it still called out to [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Forceful individuals]] that passed through the system, imploring them to reassemble the shattered pieces.<ref name="SS" />
